skill_name: Create a story about a student who learns a valuable lesson
workflow: Once there was a student named Joe who lived in a small town. Joe was an intelligent and hardworking student but he often got caught up in the mundane of school and day-to-day life. He was accustomed to following instructions and routines without question. One day, his teacher asked the class to think outside of the box and come up with a project that could potentially innovate the community. Joe took it upon himself to use his skills to create an app that could help his community stay informed
